title: "Objectives & prerequisites"

## Learning objectives

::: {.callout-note title="Learning objectives"}
- Identify a Sandcastle-produced Git branch as the **durable input**
  the composition layer consumes.
- Promote the greeting `value` from `rules/hello.yaml` on that branch
  into the `spec.value` field of a Crossplane
  **CompositeResource** (`XHelloWorldPico`).
- Demonstrate that the generated XR is byte-equivalent to the reference
  `05-xr.yaml` the
  [Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab](../hello-pico-on-kubernetes/index.qmd)
  ships — so it drops in without modification.
- Recognise that the hand-off itself is the **construct → compose**
  boundary in the academy story _Crossplane composes, Sandcastle
  constructs, Picos behave_.
:::

## Prerequisites

::: {.callout-note title="Prerequisites"}
- Completion of the
  [Hello World Pico Sandcastle lab](../hello-world-pico-sandcastle/index.qmd)
  — you need the durable `sandcastle/hello-world-pico` branch on
  `work/hello-world-pico-sandcastle/target-repo`. If it is missing,
  the lab's `verify.sh` will run the Sandcastle lab for you.
- Familiarity with the
  [Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab](../hello-pico-on-kubernetes/index.qmd)
  at the level of its walkthrough steps 1–4 (install Crossplane,
  install the Kubernetes provider, register the XRD and Composition).
  A cluster is **not** required for this lab; if you choose to apply
  the generated XR in a cluster afterwards, the canonical local
  minikube setup home is the
  [Kubernetes course setup foundation](../../courses/kubernetes/index.html).
:::

## Environment

- **Supported OS**: macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel), Linux, or WSL.
- **Required shell**: `bash` 3.2+ or `zsh` 5.0+.
- **Required tools** (all invoked directly by the walkthrough):
  - `bash` and standard POSIX utilities (`grep`, `sed`, `cat`).
  - `git` — reads the Sandcastle-produced branch.
  - `python3` — parses the rule value and validates the generated XR.
- **PATH expectation**: `bash`, `git`, and `python3` must all resolve
  on `PATH`. No cluster tooling (`kubectl`, `helm`, `minikube`) is
  required for this lab.
- **Estimated time**: **15–30 minutes**.
- **Cleanup step** (also repeated at the end of the walkthrough):

  ```bash
  rm -rf work/handoff-sandcastle-to-kubernetes
  ```

## Install commands

If any tool above is missing, install it using its upstream instructions
before starting the walkthrough. On macOS with Homebrew:

```bash
brew install git python3
```

On Linux, use your distribution's package manager (`apt`, `dnf`, etc.).
Confirm each tool resolves before you begin:

```bash
command -v bash    && bash --version | head -1
command -v git     && git --version
command -v python3 && python3 --version
```

## One-time setup (optional)

The hand-off script reads the Sandcastle-produced branch from
`work/hello-world-pico-sandcastle/target-repo` by default. If your
Sandcastle work-root is elsewhere, set `SANDCASTLE_WORK` when invoking
`handoff.sh` or `verify.sh`.
